## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (lint, types, tests) and `npm run format:check` is clean.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for the behaviour that changed.
- [ ] Every user-visible string is in `messages/ar.json`, `messages/fr.json` and `messages/en.json`; no raw key reaches the screen.
- [ ] Any schema change is a new migration under `supabase/migrations/` with a test in `tests/db/`; no applied migration was edited.
- [ ] Nothing here adds a built-in kind of learning, passes user data into the sandboxed player, adds a commercial feature, or introduces demo or placeholder content.
- [ ] No `.env*` file, secret, generated folder or specification document is included.
